elements.description: A back view of a male character with distinctive spiky black hair rendered in stark black and white contrast. The hair has jagged, flame-like points creating a dramatic silhouette against the halftone screentone background. The character wears what appears to be a dark collared shirt or jacket. The art style features bold, clean line work with solid black fills for the hair and clothing, contrasted against detailed screentone patterns in the background. The composition is split across two panels - the upper panel shows the full back of the head and neck, while the lower panel shows a closer crop focusing on the shoulder and hair area. The lineart is confident with varying weights, and the shading relies primarily on solid blacks rather than gradual tones, creating a high-contrast aesthetic typical of manga illustration.

This appears to be a partially visible speech bubble cropped at the edge of the panel. Only a curved black outline is visible, showing the characteristic rounded border typical of manga speech bubbles. The line weight is consistent and medium thickness, drawn with clean, smooth curves. The bubble appears to be cut off by the panel border, with most of its content area not visible in this crop. There is no visible text or other content within the visible portion. The style is typical of standard manga speech bubble design with simple, clean lineart and no additional decorative elements or special effects.
